نفتحل (form VIII)
# نَفْتَحِلُ (naftaḥilu) /naf.ta.ħi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# نُفْتَحَلُ (nuftaḥalu) /nuf.ta.ħa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# نَفْتَحِلَ (naftaḥila) /naf.ta.ħi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# نُفْتَحَلَ (nuftaḥala) /nuf.ta.ħa.la/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
